shelfLife: 12 months in an opaque or cupboard-stored airtight jar
whatItIs: NaturesMud Moringa Leaf Powder is made exclusively from tender, hand-stripped green leaves of Moringa oleifera (known in Nepal as Sajiwan / सजिवन or Sahijan / सहिजन, and locally in parts of the hills as Shitalchini). We discard woody stems and stalks, gently shade-dry the washed leaves at low temperatures so chlorophyll turns vibrant emerald green rather than brown, and micro-mill them into a fine leaf powder.
nepaliKitchenUses: Everyday Dal & Tarkari Finisher: Stir 1/2 to 1 teaspoon (3g–5g) into cooked kalo dal, yellow mung dal, or mixed vegetable tarkari right before serving so heat does not dull its green nutrients.
Morning Warm Lemon-Moringa Water: Whisk 1/2 teaspoon into a glass of lukewarm water with a squeeze of fresh lemon and a pinch of Himalayan Pink Salt.
Green Roti & Paratha Dough: Knead 1 tablespoon into 2 cups of whole-wheat atta to prepare mineral-rich green rotis for the whole family.
Savory Mohi (Buttermilk) & Curd: Blend 1/2 teaspoon into afternoon mohi or dahi with roasted jeera and Bire Noon.
whoItSuits: Ideal for adults, working professionals, vegetarians seeking plant-based iron, calcium, and amino acids, elders wanting easy leafy-green nutrition without chewing fibrous greens, and families fortifying daily dal and roti.
monsoonStorage: Chlorophyll and plant polyphenols are sensitive to direct sunlight and humidity. Store your Moringa Leaf Powder jar inside a dark kitchen cabinet away from windows and stove heat, and keep the lid tightly closed during monsoon months.

faqs.q: What is Moringa called in Nepali and what is its price in Nepal?
faqs.a: Moringa is called Sajiwan (सजिवन) or Sahijan (सहिजन) in Nepali (also referred to locally as Shitalchini / शीतलचिनी). NaturesMud Moringa Leaf Powder (100 GM) is priced at Rs. 690 in Nepal.

faqs.q: How much Moringa Leaf Powder should I take daily (दैनिक कति खाने)?
faqs.a: Start with 1/2 teaspoon (about 2.5g) per day for the first week, then use 1 teaspoon (5g) daily mixed into warm water, dal, soup, or roti dough.

faqs.q: Why is NaturesMud Moringa Powder bright green instead of brown?
faqs.a: We harvest young green leaves and dry them gently in shaded sanitary trays away from scorching UV sunlight, preserving natural chlorophyll and leaf nutrients.

faqs.q: Does Moringa Leaf Powder taste bitter?
faqs.a: Pure moringa leaf has a mild, earthy, spinach-like flavor with a slight peppery finish. Mixing it into lemon water, dal, or smoothies balances the earthy taste naturally.

faqs.q: Can children eat Moringa Leaf Powder?
faqs.a: For older children, a small pinch (1/4 tsp) kneaded into roti dough or stirred into dal is an easy way to add leafy greens. For infants (6M+), consult your pediatrician first.
